definitions.explanation: A structured display of information organized in rows and columns, or a list or schedule. Common in academic, business, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時刻表|じこくひょう}→時刻表：01031_jikokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{表|ひょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please organize the data into a table.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一覧表|いちらんひょう}→一覧表：22737_ichiranhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I attached a reference list at the end of the report.

notes:
Refers to organized displays of information — tables, charts, lists, and schedules. Extremely productive as a suffix in compound words. Note that this is a different word from ⟦{表|おもて}→表：01355_omote⟧ (surface, front side).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{時刻表|じこくひょう}→時刻表：01031_jikokuhyou⟧ — timetable
- ⟦{一覧表|いちらんひょう}→一覧表：22737_ichiranhyou⟧ — list, catalog
- ⟦{成績表|せいせきひょう}→成績表：09289_seisekihyou⟧ — report card, grade sheet
- ⟦{料金表|りょうきんひょう}→料金表：21923_ryoukinhyou⟧ — price list
- {年表|ねんぴょう} — chronological table, timeline
- ⟦{図表|ずひょう}→図表：04317_zuhyou⟧ — charts and tables
- ⟦{対照表|たいしょうひょう}→対照表：30043_taishouhyou⟧ — comparison table
- {換算表|かんさんひょう} — conversion table

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表|ひょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧ — to organize into a table
- {表|ひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ — to make a table/chart
- {表|ひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — to look at a table

DIFFERENT READINGS OF {表|ひょう}:
- ⟦{表|おもて}→表：01355_omote⟧ — surface, front side, outside (different word)
- {表|ひょう} — table, chart (this entry)
- Both readings are very common but have completely different meanings.
